bullets: If Komi Store crashes, you can share the crash log from Tweaks → App.
App pages in Classic no longer freeze for installed apps.
README tables, like team and contributor grids, no longer show up as code.
An empty release list is checked on GitHub before a repository shows "No releases".
The Update button shows right after an update check and opens on the new release.
Auto-translate now also covers release notes after you switch channel or app, or retry.
Direct GitHub is always offered in the download mirror list.
The signature check before an update stays on after an app is updated outside Komi Store.
